sources.title: Retkikartta
sources.blurb: Metsahallitus hiking maps with filterable overlays. The gold standard for trail-level detail in national parks and state hiking areas.

sources.title: outdoors.fi
sources.blurb: Metsahallitus's English-language portal for national parks and hiking areas. Backs the national-parks layer on the map.

sources.title: Uuvi (Uusimaa)
sources.blurb: Full list of recreation, outdoor, and nature destinations in Uusimaa. Useful when planning short trips around Helsinki.

sources.title: Retkipaikka
sources.blurb: User-written hiking destination tips and trip reports. Good for trail-condition narratives and lesser-known spots.

sources.title: Ulkoliikunta winter map
sources.blurb: Map of winter routes for cross-country skiing, skating, and ice swimming across Finland.

sources.title: Suomen luonnon pyhapaikat
sources.blurb: Curated Google My Maps list of Finnish natural sacred sites.

sources.title: Jarviwiki
sources.blurb: Citizen-maintained wiki of Finnish lakes with water-quality data, observations, and lake-specific articles.

sources.title: Suomen vesiputoukset
sources.blurb: Catalogue of Finnish waterfalls with photos and access notes.

sources.title: Viinitilat
sources.blurb: Finnish small wineries directory. Often combine well with weekend countryside trips.

sources.title: Finnish small breweries (Google My Maps)
sources.blurb: Crowd-curated map of Finnish small breweries.

sources.title: Kyppi (Museovirasto archaeology)
sources.blurb: Finnish Heritage Agency database of archaeological sites and protected built heritage.

sources.title: Pikakartta
sources.blurb: Generate a printable A4 trail map of any area in seconds. Useful as a paper backup.

sources.title: Suomen luolat (Luolaseura)
sources.blurb: Finnish Caving Society's master list of Finnish caves with descriptions, photos, and published WGS84 + ETRS-TM35FIN coordinates per cave. Source of the Caves layer.

sources.title: Offline maps for Garmin / Android / iOS
sources.blurb: Whole-Finland topographic map files for Garmin (IMG / MapSource), Android (Mapsforge: Oruxmaps, Locus), and iOS (Cartograph). Includes OSM-sourced marked hiking routes, laavus, and wilderness huts. Refreshed regularly. Use these for offline navigation when the phone is out of range.

sources.title: 112 Suomi
sources.blurb: Gives your GPS location to the emergency dispatcher, plus shortcuts to maritime rescue and other useful numbers.

sources.title: St John Ambulance First Aid
sources.blurb: First aid reference for adults.

sources.title: Baby & Child First Aid
sources.blurb: First aid reference for babies and children.

sources.title: Useful Knots
sources.blurb: Animated guide to knots, categorised by use.

sources.title: Rewindr
sources.blurb: Trail tracking and related statistics.

sources.title: Heavens-Above
sources.blurb: Camera-based AR for stars, satellites, and constellations in real time.

sources.title: GPS Status
sources.blurb: A toolkit for the device GPS receiver: satellite info, signal quality, raw coordinates.

sources.title: Retkikartta (app)
sources.blurb: Map browser with hiking trails and sites marked. Good for printing your own DIY map sheets.

sources.title: TrailMap
sources.blurb: Finnish trail maps.

sources.title: Topo GPS
sources.blurb: Topographic maps for offline GPS use.

sources.title: Karttaselain
sources.blurb: Browse Finnish topographical maps, including offline use.

sources.title: Custom Maps
sources.blurb: Adds GPS overlay to any ad-hoc image of a map.

sources.title: Tulipaikka
sources.blurb: Browsable map of all fire sites in Finland.

sources.title: c:geo
sources.blurb: Unofficial geocaching app with rich offline support.

sources.title: Geocaching
sources.blurb: Official Geocaching.com app.

sources.title: Camera FV-5
sources.blurb: Manual-control camera app with many photographic options.

sources.title: Airdata UAV
sources.blurb: Drone flight log + weather prediction.

sources.title: UAV Forecast
sources.blurb: Drone-specific weather and flight-suitability forecast.

sources.title: AirMap
sources.blurb: Airspace regulation data for drone pilots.

sources.title: AviaMaps
sources.blurb: Airspace regulation map with a drone filter.

sources.title: Supersää
sources.blurb: Iltasanomat Supersää -- detailed forecast and radar across Finland.

sources.title: FMI (detailed Uusimaa weather)
sources.blurb: Finnish Meteorological Institute testbed dashboard with fine-grained Uusimaa weather observations and short-range model output.

sources.title: Luontoon.fi (Metsähallitus)
sources.blurb: Metsähallitus's national-parks portal: official descriptions, services, photo galleries, and the per-park exceptional-situations alert pages. User-facing source for the National parks, Wilderness areas and Nature reserves layers.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap (hiking routes)
sources.blurb: Community-mapped route=hiking relations, from short local loops to multi-hundred-km regional routes like Hämeen Ilvesreitti. Source for the Hiking trails layer.

sources.title: Lounaistieto: harmonised regional plans (maakuntakaavat)
sources.blurb: Finland's regional councils' land-use plans in a shared data model, filtered to the recreation-area zoning code. Source for the Regional plan recreation areas layer. Coverage is incomplete - see the Data sources tab for which regions are missing or only partially covered.

sources.title: Natura 2000 -verkosto (ymparisto.fi)
sources.blurb: Finnish Ministry of the Environment's overview of the EU Natura 2000 network. Many large multi-use recreation areas (e.g. Kytäjä-Usmi) are not themselves a statutory nature reserve but sit inside a much larger Natura boundary - source for the Natura 2000 areas layer.

sources.title: laavu.org
sources.blurb: Community-maintained directory of laavus, kotas, lean-to shelters and wilderness huts across Finland. Backs the Laavus, kotas, Lean-tos and Wilderness huts layers.

sources.title: Saunas in nature (Google Sheet)
sources.blurb: Hand-curated spreadsheet of public saunas reachable on foot. Source for the Saunas in nature layer.

sources.title: Saunalista (public saunas in Finland)
sources.blurb: Directory of ~240 paid public saunas across Finland, including wood-fired, smoke, lakeside and urban saunas with entry-fee details. Complements the Saunas in nature spreadsheet, which focuses on free saunas reachable on foot.

sources.title: huts.fi (Finland)
sources.blurb: Directory of huts and shelters in Finland.

sources.title: Uimaan.fi (swimming spots)
sources.blurb: Crowdsourced directory of Finnish swimming spots (LIPAS-backed). Source for the Local beaches layer.

sources.title: SYKE Uimarannat (bathing waters)
sources.blurb: EU Bathing Water Directive register: official Finnish public swimming beaches with water-quality classifications. Source for the Public swimming beaches layer.

sources.title: RKY (built heritage)
sources.blurb: Museovirasto's register of nationally significant built-heritage environments. Source for the Open-air museums and ruins layer.

sources.title: Suomen Lintuatlas (4th, 2022-2025)
sources.blurb: Fourth Finnish breeding-bird atlas. Maps recorded species in every 10x10 km grid square. Source for the Bird Atlas layer.

sources.title: Suomen Perhostutkijain Seura (NAFI)
sources.blurb: Finnish Lepidopterological Society. Runs the NAFI butterfly-transect monitoring scheme that feeds the Butterflies layer.

sources.title: Laji.fi (FinBIF portal)
sources.blurb: Finnish Biodiversity Information Facility portal. Browse all species observations and atlas data; download the underlying Bombus, butterfly, and bird-atlas datasets.

sources.title: Luke - Large carnivore monitoring
sources.blurb: Natural Resources Institute Finland tracks wolf, bear, lynx and wolverine populations. Background for the Wolves, bears, lynx layer.

sources.title: Luke - National Forest Inventory (NFI)
sources.blurb: Natural Resources Institute Finland's National Forest Inventory: growing-stock volume by tree species and region. Source for the Tree species composition layer.

sources.title: Norkko (pollen forecast)
sources.blurb: University of Turku Aerobiology Unit. Daily Finnish pollen forecast and observation map. Companion source to the Pollen forecast layer (which uses Open-Meteo's gridded version).

sources.title: Punkkilive (tick observations)
sources.blurb: Citizen-science tick observation map (Pfizer / UTU). Complements the Tick observation density layer.

sources.title: FMI safety warnings
sources.blurb: Finnish Meteorological Institute current weather warnings: wind, thunderstorm, forest fire, ice. User-facing version of the CAP feed in the Weather warnings layer.

sources.title: FMI air quality
sources.blurb: Live air-quality index map for Finnish monitoring stations. User-facing source for the Air quality stations layer.

sources.title: Forum Virium Uiras
sources.blurb: Live Helsinki swimming-water temperature sensor network. Source for the Live water temperature layer.

sources.title: vesi.fi Water situation
sources.blurb: Live Finnish water-situation dashboard (vesi.fi): water level, discharge, ice thickness and snow for ~1750 monitoring stations. Source for the River and lake water levels layer. (Replaces the retired wwwi3.ymparisto.fi portal.)

sources.title: SYKE Avoin tieto
sources.blurb: SYKE open data catalogue. Hosts the four nationally-valuable geological-formation inventories (bedrock, boulder, moraine, eolian + shore) plus the algae citizen-observation database.
